data.description:
## Description

**What**: Update existing docs (CLAUDE.md, plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md if needed for cross-link, KNOWN-ISSUES.md if recurring patterns appear) to reflect the Strata-aware onboarding extensions: detector + prompts/strata/ + dialog + completion-verifier checks. Follow .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md.
**Why**: Future agents must know about strata.skip, the resume one-liner, and the prompts/strata/ contract.
**Scope**:
- IN: Concise updates to listed docs; cross-link from CLAUDE.md to prompts/strata/README.md and detect-strata.sh.
- OUT: New documentation files; restructuring CLAUDE.md beyond targeted updates.

## Done Definitions
- When complete, CLAUDE.md references prompts/strata/ contract and the strata.skip degradation key
- When complete, .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md formatting is followed
- When complete, KNOWN-ISSUES.md captures any A2-specific recovery notes (version-skew, resume one-liner)

## Considerations
- [Maintainability] Concise; link don't copy

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: Update project docs to reflect Strata-aware onboarding
